Package index

Package overview

Overview of the MultiStateTMLE package.

MultiStateTMLE MultiStateTMLE-package
MultiStateTMLE: Causal Inference for Multistate Event Processes via TMLE

Initial fit

Fitting the initial (nuisance) hazard models and building the discrete product state space used internally.

fit_initial()
Fit the initial hazard models
hazard_model()
Specify the hazard model of an event process

Targeted estimation

Estimating a target parameter under a stochastic intensity intervention, fixed or calibrated.

tmle_estimate()
Targeted estimation under a stochastic intensity intervention
risk() years_lost()
Target parameters
scale_intensity() calibrate() level() absolute_change() relative_change()
Stochastic intensity interventions

Calibration

Tracing the intervention curve, and decomposing treatment effects into calibrated contrasts.

intervention_curve()
Trace the intervention curve over a grid of intensity scalings
calibrated_contrasts()
Decompose a treatment effect into mediated and calibrated contrasts

Results

Printing, extracting estimates from, and computing confidence intervals for the result objects.

print(<initial_fit>) print(<tmle_estimate>) print(<intervention_curve>) print(<calibrated_contrasts>) coef(<tmle_estimate>) confint(<tmle_estimate>)
Methods for the result objects
